metadata.title: A safer practice workspace
metadata.description: Five fictional screens. Practise visibility, invitations, notifications and recovery with explanations and retries.
metadata.credits: Original artwork and teaching text by Meiram Bakhytzhan. MIT licensed.

nodes.title: Keep your classroom private
nodes.instruction: Set visibility so only invited learners can enter. Choose a region or the equivalent text action.
nodes.imageDescription: The visibility page offers Public, Private, and Shared link. Public is open to everyone; Private admits invited learners; a shared link admits anyone who has it.

actions.label: Choose Public
actions.feedback: Public access lets people outside your class discover the workspace. Choose Private to keep practice within the invited group.

actions.label: Choose Private
actions.feedback: Private access keeps this exercise within your invited group.

actions.label: Choose Shared link
actions.feedback: Links can be forwarded beyond the classroom. Private invitations give you clearer control over who can enter. Try again.

nodes.title: Invite intentionally
nodes.instruction: Choose the invitation for your classroom group.
nodes.imageDescription: The invitations page offers Invite with class code and Invite everyone.

actions.label: Invite with class code
actions.feedback: A class code keeps the invitation focused on your intended group.

actions.label: Invite everyone
actions.feedback: Inviting everyone expands access beyond your practice group. Use your class code instead.

nodes.title: Make room for focus
nodes.instruction: Keep essential notifications without an alert for every activity.
nodes.imageDescription: The preferences page offers Essential only and Every activity.

actions.label: Essential only
actions.feedback: Essential notifications keep important task updates visible.

actions.label: Every activity
actions.feedback: An alert for every click can interrupt practice. Keep essential updates and try again.

nodes.title: Keep a recovery copy
nodes.instruction: Prepare a copy that survives clearing browser storage.
nodes.imageDescription: The recovery page offers Download a backup and Skip backup.

actions.label: Download a backup
actions.feedback: A separate copy can be reopened if browser storage is cleared.

actions.label: Skip backup
actions.feedback: Browser storage can be cleared or evicted. Download a backup to keep a separate recovery copy.

nodes.title: Apply your settings
nodes.instruction: Review the choices and apply the settings.
nodes.imageDescription: The review page confirms private access, class invitations, essential updates and a recovery copy. Apply settings is the available action.

nodes.title: Ready for practice
nodes.completionText: You chose private access, invited a focused group, kept essential notifications and prepared a recovery copy. These small choices make a calmer practice space.
